Leave it to me to play these games in the wrong order.

Prison Run and Gun plays a lot like Shootout on Cash Island (SoCI). It has a lot of the same features, except mainly, for the mostly confined, tight quarters, prison setting. There's guns, grenades and all the like. Instead of the collectible jars on each stage though, there are keys to collect which require you to use an extra few brain cells. And well, there's no cash scattered around each level. There's a few new enemies and other obstacles too. I really love the fast-paced gameplay that can be extremely punishing if you don't carefully plan out your next move.

I absolutely recommend this game, as with SoCI, if you enjoy a little less conventional of a platformer. I'll definitely be playing Mission Ammunition in the near future!

I am 32 years old.

My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and we adopted our son together. Both are now 4 years old.

When we were going through our separation, I felt lost and unhappy. I was self-destructive. One day, I was so angry with everything spiraling out of control that I punched a concrete wall in a moment of overwhelming emotion. This resulted in breaking my fifth metacarpal in my right hand—the hand I worked with, played games with, and used to carry my children to bed—the hand I desperately needed to ensure I could continue providing.

Upon learning the severity of the self-inflicted damage, I became almost suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man, with no history of depression or anxiety. I had never experienced anger outbursts, nor was I the type to break down and cry, but I was in a tough situation that truly prevented me from seeing the light on the other side.

With nothing better to do, I looked for a game I could play WITH ONE HAND while recovering. Somehow, I stumbled upon this game and read some of the comments. I decided it was worth a try... I must admit I didn't beat the game, nor did I play as much as some of you. In fact, I may have played this game for only a day or two. That being said, after doing so, I had a new joy and hope for life. I managed to leave behind the pain and suffering that had been thrust upon me. I could experience the joy and happiness of other people. I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ minutes listening to this music, long enough to realize that I would be okay.

After realizing this, I turned off the game and went back to work. My hand hurt a lot, but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so sorry for myself and became the father I needed to be at that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving like.

Today, I am close friends with the mother of my children. We don't fight, argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents and friends.

Now I have 3 children. My third child is, wait, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my separation, and we just unexpectedly stumbled into each other's lives. We have been dating for a year and are very happy together.

Moral of the story: you never know what life has in store for you, and if I had given up when all odds were against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

Thank you.

"Prison Run and Gun", nostaljik unsurları çağdaş oynanış ve mekaniklerle kusursuz bir şekilde birleştiren büyüleyici bir retro bulmaca platform oyunudur. Sıcak Silahlar Ekibi'nden Jake'in önemli bir rol oynadığı bir devlet hapishanesindeki son olayların arka planında geçen oyun, cesur mahkumların özgürlük için kaçmaları için mükemmel bir fırsat olarak ortaya çıkıyor ve siz de onlardan biri oluyorsunuz.

Oyunun temeli, özgürlükle aranızda duran 30 zorlu bölümden geçmek için becerilerinizi ve silah cephaneliğinizi kullanmak etrafında dönüyor. Bulmaca çözme ve platform öğelerinin birleşimi, oyuna karmaşık bir katman ekleyerek her bölümü benzersiz ve heyecan verici bir deneyim haline getiriyor.

"Prison Run and Gun "ın retro estetiği, pikselli sanat tarzını ve chiptune müziğini takdir eden oyuncular için bir nostalji duygusu uyandırarak klasik video oyunlarına saygı duruşunda bulunuyor. Bununla birlikte, oyun modern oynanış ve mekanikleri sorunsuz bir şekilde entegre ederek tüm geçmişlere sahip oyuncular için dinamik ve ilgi çekici bir deneyim sağlıyor.

Team Hot Guns'tan Jake karakteri, oyuna ilgi çekici bir anlatı unsuru katarak hapishanedeki olaylar ile oyun dünyasının daha geniş bağlamı arasında bir bağlantı oluşturuyor. Bu anlatı dizisi, genel oyun deneyimine derinlik katarak oyunculara her bölümde sunulan zorlukların üstesinden gelmeleri için zorlayıcı bir neden sağlıyor.

Oyuncular 30 bölüm boyunca ilerlerken, engelleri ve düşmanları aşmak için stratejik düşünme, hızlı refleksler ve hassas silah kullanımının bir kombinasyonuna güvenmek zorundadırlar. Zorlukların çeşitliliği oyunu taze tutuyor ve oyuncuların yaklaşımlarını sürekli olarak uyarlamalarını sağlıyor.

"Prison Run and Gun" sadece bir beceri testi değil; aynı zamanda bir zeka testi. Bulmacalar ve platform unsurları oyuncuları yaratıcı düşünmeye ve hareketlerini stratejiye dökmeye zorlayarak her bölümün üstesinden gelirken tatmin edici bir başarı hissi yaratıyor.

Sonuç olarak, "Prison Run and Gun" retro cazibesini modern oynanışla başarılı bir şekilde birleştirerek ilgi çekici ve zorlu bir deneyim sunuyor. İster klasik oyunların hayranı ister platform türüne yeni başlayan biri olun, oyun, eyalet hapishanesinin pençelerinden kurtulmak için çabalarken keyifli ve sürükleyici bir yolculuk sunuyor. Becerilerinizi kullanmaya, silahlarınızı kuşanmaya ve özgürlüğe doğru heyecan verici bir kaçışa hazır olun!

Очень понравилось, что каждые несколько уровней геймплей изменяется, и ты не просто проходишь уровни посложнее, а изучаешь их механики, прежде чем эти уровни пройти. К сожалению, в игре только 30 уровней, поэтому очень не наиграешься.

Oyunumuz 30 bölümden oluşan hapishaneden kaçma temalı bir bulmaca oyunu. Bölüm içi hedef genelde var olan bir tane ana çıkış kapısına ulaşmak oluyor. Ve bir de isteğe bağlı olarak saklı olan anahtarları bulmak. ana çıkış kapısı ise elektrikli geçitler, başka kapılar ve kutu türevi şeylerle kapanmış oluyor. Bunları da patlatarak veya silahla ateş ederek yok edip çıkışa ulaşıyoruz. 

Zor mu peki? Bölümün stratejisini belirlemek çok zor değil diye düşünüyorum. Normal zorlukta. Sadece bir bölümün mantığını gerçekten anlamadım. Asıl zor olan oynayabilmek. Oynayışı çok sıkıntılı ve çok basit hatalardan dolayı bölüme yeniden başlayınca sinirleriniz iyice bozuluyor. Kıyafetle mayınlı adamların üzerinden ikinci kez zıplama becerisinin düzgün çalışmaması ve sadece zıplarken roketi harcaması beni defalarca bölümü yeniden oynamaya ittiği için aldığım bütün keyfi yok etti diyebilirim.
 
Oyun oynanabilir ama 5 liradan fazla verilmez diye düşünmekteyim. Son olarak bir şey daha. Oyunda neden elinde mayınla koşan çıplak adamlar var ahaha

"Prison Run and Gun" is a mobile app that's been dumped on Steam as if it was a real PC game (it's not)... it's a cash grab from greedy mobile devs.  The game is on the app stores as "Prison Run and Minigun" if you want to play this free mobile app.  This mobile app is yet another of literally thousands of 2D retro pixel platformers infesting Steam and lowering the average quality of all video games everywhere.  This one has a prison escape theme and puzzle elements as you work out how to use a gun to solve problems.  There's some moral in that story but I can't be bothered, let's talk about this mobile app and why it sucks.

From a technical perspective, as a mobile app, this doesn't meet basic minimum requirements that most PC gamers expect as standard.

A choice was made to use obsolete, decades old retro pixel "art" as a substitute for contemporary PC graphics.  It's unclear if this is due to lack of budget or talent, regardless, the overall visual quality of the game is extremely low as a result.

While there are options to change the resolution for the mobile app, all this does is scale up the simplistic 2D art assets used to make the mobile app, which makes little or no difference to the graphics quality.  Without any other substantial graphics tweaks, it's not possible for gamers to improve the lacklustre 2D visuals.

PC gamers will be insulted by the presence of console peasant children's toy controller prompts, despite this being on PC.  Developers should try to be aware which platform they're developing for.

Because this is a mobile app, it carries a number of deliberate design deficiencies.  Compromises were made to cater to the iPhones that the mobile app was designed for.  These are unfortunate handicaps and limitations that PC gamers shouldn't be forced to accept, but it's evident that PC was an afterthought for the iPhone developers who are to blame for this.  The mobile app is deficient as a result of these choices, and would have been so much better without the handicaps that designing games for mobile phones forces upon a game.  Once more, mobile devs have made gaming worse for everyone.  I didn't spend thousands on building a gaming rig just so I could pretend it's an iPhone.

These technical defects push this mobile app below acceptable standards for any modern PC game.

"Prison Run and Gun" didn't appeal much to the people who own a copy of the mobile app, either.  It has achievements, and they show us a very clear picture that the mobile app didn't really capture any interest from gamers.  The most commonly and easily attained achievement is for progressing far enough into the game to collect a key (trivial to do, happens within minutes of starting the game), but only around 14 percent of players bothered to get that far before uninstalling the mobile app.  Hardly a success story, gamers just weren't all that interested in the mobile app.

Reviewing SteamDB to check how popular this mobile app was with players reveals a surprise... there's a very healthy spike in player counts for the mobile app.  But this isn't consistent with the achievement stats, that show only 14 percent of players bothered playing the mobile app for any reasonable amount of time.  How is it possible for this mobile app to have so many concurrent players who weren't even playing the mobile app?  Trading cards.  Players will use card idling software to collect the cards and sell them, but this won't trigger any achievements in-game.  That tells us people only really bought this mobile app for trading cards, and that's a damning indictment of the woeful quality.  A closer look at the numbers shows the mobile app just has a couple of players every week running up the mobile app and idling it for cards, then deleting it.  We must ask how it benefits gamers for there to be so many games like this, with no merit as a serious game, that only generate sales from people idling and selling the trading cards.

Once more we see greedy mobile devs trying to scam PC gamers. On Steam, this is $5 USD, on app stores, it's free. Mobile devs must learn PC gamers are not here to be gouged, and can't be expected to pay FIVE BUCKS FOR A FREE MOBILE APP just because it's been lazily dumped on Steam.  This is unacceptable disrespect for PC gamers.  Because this can be played free elsewhere, and because of the other defects, it's impossible to recommend.  Who do they think we are?

Отзывы никто не читает, поэтому напишу рецепт блинов.

- Ингредиенты:
молоко 1 литр
яйцо 2 — 4 шт
сахар 1 — 2 ст.л.
соль щепотка
сода 0,5 ч.л. и 1 ч.л. уксуса, чтобы её погасить
рафинированное растительное масло 2 — 4 ст.л
пшеничная мука в/с 3 стакана (объём стакана 200 мл)
сливочное масло для смазки готовых блинов 200 гр

- Пошаговый рецепт приготовления:

Подогрейте молоко до t 40° С и разделите его на две части по 0,5 литра. Так будет удобнее замешивать тесто и в нём не будет комочков.

Разбейте в миску яйца, добавьте соль и сахар. Взбейте венчиком, до образования пены.

Добавьте в миску со взбитыми яйцами 0,5 литра тёплого молока и перемешайте.

Постепенно добавляйте просеянную муку и перемешивайте до однородной массы, так, чтобы не было комочков.

У вас должно получиться гладкое и густое тесто.

Добавьте в тесто соду, погашенную уксусом, перемешайте.

Соду можно не добавлять, тогда блинчики будут без дырочек и более эластичные.

Добавьте оставшиеся 0,5 литра тёплого молока и растительное масло, тщательно перемешайте.

Нагрейте блинницу, налейте на неё тесто и выпекайте блинчики сначала с одной, потом с другой стороны.

Готовый блинчик снимите на тарелку.

На блинницу налейте следующую порцию теста и, пока оно жарится, смажьте предыдущий блин сливочным маслом, пока он ещё горячий.

《Prison Run and Gun》是一款备受期待的动作冒险游戏，以其独特的越狱题材、复古像素风格以及宣称的高难度挑战吸引了众多玩家的眼球。然而在深度体验这款游戏后，我发现它并未完全兑现其承诺的乐趣，反而在多个方面暴露出显著的问题，使得游戏体验大打折扣。

首先不得不提的是操作手感。本以为能感受到类似《合金弹头》般的流畅爽快，但实际上游戏中的角色移动和射击反馈僵硬，特别是在快速反应和精确操作方面，游戏的控制设计显得不尽如人意。而游戏标榜的高难度并非源于精巧的关卡设计，更多的是由于操作不灵敏和判定机制严苛带来的困扰，这种难度给人感觉更像是挫败而非挑战的乐趣。

尽管游戏包含了丰富的关卡数量，但各个关卡之间的差异性并不显著，许多场景和敌人的布置显得机械重复，缺乏新鲜感。关卡内的解谜元素和道具使用过于直白简单，欠缺深度和策略性，久而久之，玩家会陷入一种不断重复相同动作的疲倦感中。

在技术层面的表现亦不尽人意。游戏时常出现卡顿和掉帧的现象，特别是在复杂的场景转换和大量敌人同时出现时，性能表现的短板尤为突出。此外还存在一定的bug，例如角色卡在场景中无法行动，或是关键道具莫名消失等问题，严重影响了游戏的整体流畅度和玩家的正常体验。

作为一款包含叙事元素的动作游戏，在剧情构建和角色发展上显得相当乏力。游戏故事线过于简单直接，缺乏引人入胜的情节转折和角色性格刻画，这让整个越狱过程变得枯燥无味，玩家很难对主角的命运产生共鸣或投入情感。

尽管游戏具有独特的艺术风格和极具吸引力的概念，但在实际游玩过程中，其操作手感不佳、关卡设计雷同、技术问题频现以及剧情上的空洞，共同构成了一个低于预期的游戏体验。希望开发商能够在未来更新中积极采纳玩家反馈，针对上述问题进行大幅改进，让这款原本充满潜力的作品真正焕发光彩。在当前状态下恐怕难以满足多数玩家对于高质量动作冒险游戏的期待。
